title: Fixed-word equality test in linear time
statement: For all fixed Boolean words $w_0,u,v$, there are a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and a constant $c\in\mathbb{N}$ such that, on every Boolean input $w$, $M$ outputs $u$ if $w=w_0$ and outputs $v$ otherwise, and halts within $c(|w|+1)$ steps.
replaced:
For all fixed Boolean words $w_0$, $u$, $v$ there exist a multi-tape Turing
machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and a constant $c$ such that $M$ computes
in time $c \cdot (n + 1)$ the function sending a Boolean word $w$ to $u$ when
$w = w_0$ and to $v$ otherwise.
